scope: Read-only extraction integration readiness audit; no extraction or model call performed

queries.timestamped_documents: SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE extracted_at IS NOT NULL
queries.timestamped_with_error: SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE extracted_at IS NOT NULL AND extract_error IS NOT NULL
queries.documents_below_default_word_floor: SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE words < 60
queries.document_url_cell_links: SELECT count(*) FROM urls u JOIN url_cells uc USING(url) WHERE u.doc_id IS NOT NULL

findings: Generic extraction reads all text chunks unless caller sets max_chunks; selected text may still omit PDF/image content.
Default chunk size 7000, overlap 400, concurrency 8, attempts 4; only first 16 cells shown; prompt asks at most 12 claims per chunk.
extract() error handler calls put_claims(error=...), which sets extracted_at even on error; pending_documents selects only NULL extracted_at. Explicit retry reconciliation is required.
CLI budget is per invocation, not cumulative across restarts.
Source extraction candidates do not establish electoral certification, bindingness or legal force.
